'''Emthuul's''' was a large [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byrsym]] and operated by the [[Gloorag]] [[Emthuul]]. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a group of individuals from the planet [[Daimar]] traveled to the bar, to speak with the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Ballon]].
